items.author: shinybones.bsky.social
items.context:
No art streams or redeems for the next month or so. I have a semi-torn rotator cuff and in the interests of not doing more damage I am swapping over to controller games for stream. I plan on keeping Tuesdays cozy, so lemme know if you have suggestions! Hopefully I'll be back to growing in art soon!
link card: My Hero Academia: Principal Nezu's Coffee Laugh
items.text: Sorry about the shoulder, hope it heals fast. A Short Hike and Spiritfarer both play really well on a controller, and they suit a calm Tuesday stream.

items.author: daisygalvez.bsky.social
items.context: Ugh… Finally finished all Part 1’s of Fortune’s Weave. And it’s been like more than a month since I played this title. Think I need a break from long RPGs. Fuck it, tomorrow, I’m gonna either play Stardew or Fields of Mistria.
items.text: Good call after a long RPG, both are easy to pick up for short, low-pressure sessions. Enjoy the break.
